preconditions.description: The number of gnomes N is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(g) == N and all(len(row) == N for row in g)
preconditions.description: The matrix g is an N x N matrix.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= g[i][j] <= 1 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the matrix g is either 0 or 1.
The number of queries M is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= 10**9 and 1 <= x <= N for k, x in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of k between 0 and 10^9 inclusive and x between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.description: The result contains exactly 2 lines for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result[2*i], int) for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: The first line of each query result is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(result[2*i] == len(result[2*i+1]) for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: The first line of each query result matches the number of gnomes in the second line.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result[2*i+1], list) and all(isinstance(id, int) for id in result[2*i+1]) for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: The second line of each query result is a list of integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= id <= N for id in result[2*i+1]) for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: Each gnome id in the second line of each query result is between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(result[2*i+1][j] < result[2*i+1][j+1] for j in range(len(result[2*i+1])-1)) for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: The gnome ids in the second line of each query result are in increasing order.

postconditions.expression: all(result[2*i] == 0 and result[2*i+1] == [-1] if result[2*i] == 0 else True for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: If no gnomes know the joke after k minutes, the second line of the query result is [-1].
